full_prompt_en: A square late-nineteenth-century-style drawing and pastel portrait shows a bearded man in right-facing profile, wearing a tall black hat and dark suit against a vertically streaked green-beige ground. The hat fills the upper-left area, its broad brim projecting toward the right and its crown built from many short dark parallel marks. Beneath it, brown hair sweeps back above a visible ear. The man's face turns fully to the right, with a strong nose, attentive eye, and warm pale skin modeled in cream, peach, and small blue-green shadows. A curled brown mustache joins a compact full beard, the strands indicated by quick directional strokes rather than smooth painting. His jaw and neck are marked with fine cool blue lines, which add an unexpectedly lively color to the warm flesh. A dark jacket spreads across the lower half and nearly merges with the bottom edge. Narrow lapels and a dark patterned tie or neckcloth are visible at the center, with a small wedge of pale shirt collar between them. The man's forearm extends toward the lower-right corner and a portion of his pale hand appears near that edge. Behind him, the background is not a detailed room; fine vertical hatching in muted sage green and warm tan makes a textured, shallow field. The contrast between dense black clothing and light facial planes focuses attention on the profile. Soft, even light from the left brightens the cheek, nose, and collar while leaving the hat and jacket as deeper, flatter masses. Crosshatching and colored-pencil-like lines remain visible in skin, fabric, and ground. No readable lettering appears. The overall composition gives a poised conversational silhouette against a quietly vibrating background, balancing dark drawn structure with delicate tinted modeling.
full_prompt_zh: 这幅方形、具有十九世纪末风格的素描与粉彩肖像描绘一位向右呈侧面的胡须男子，戴高黑帽、穿深色西装，背景是带竖向笔痕的绿米色。帽子填满左上区域，宽帽檐向右伸出，帽冠由大量短而平行的深色笔迹构成。帽檐下，棕发在清楚可见的耳朵上方向后梳去。男子脸完全朝右，有挺直的鼻子、专注的眼睛，暖浅色肌肤由奶油色、桃色和少量蓝绿色阴影塑造。卷曲棕色髭须连着紧密的浓胡须，毛发由快捷定向笔迹而非平滑涂色表现。下颌与颈部有纤细的冷蓝线条，为暖色肌肤添上意外活跃的色彩。深色外套铺满下半幅，几乎融入底边。中央能看到狭窄翻领和深色花纹领带或领巾，它们之间露出一小块浅色衬衣领。男子前臂伸向右下角，浅色手部的一部分出现在该边附近。身后并非细致房间；低调鼠尾草绿与暖褐色细密竖排线形成有肌理的浅空间背景。浓黑衣物与浅色面部平面的反差将注意力集中在侧影上。来自左侧的柔和均匀光照亮面颊、鼻子与领口，让帽子和外套成为更深、更平的色块。交叉排线与彩铅般的笔线在皮肤、织物和背景中都可见。没有可读文字。整体构图在轻微振动般的背景前给出从容的交谈式侧影，以深色素描结构平衡细致的着色塑形。
style_prompt_en: The image has a hand-drawn pastel and colored-pencil finish, with close parallel hatching and quick directional lines remaining visible across the surface. Dense charcoal and near-black masses anchor the image, while pale cream, peach, muted green, and small blue-green shadows give lighter areas subtle life. Contours are firm at the focal silhouette but soften into fine hairlike strokes where tones overlap. Shallow even illumination separates warm raised planes from cool shadow marks without heavy cast shadows. A broad dark lower mass and upper projecting form balance an open, vertically striated ground. The background's fine repeated marks create a quiet vibrating texture rather than deep spatial description. The overall effect is intimate, observant, and briskly elegant.
style_prompt_zh: 图像具有手绘粉彩与彩铅的完成面，密集平行排线和快捷定向线条在表面清楚可见。浓炭色与近黑大块固定画面，浅奶油色、桃色、低调绿色和少量蓝绿色阴影让亮部具有细腻生气。焦点剪影的轮廓坚定，色调交叠处则柔化成细发般的笔线。浅而均匀的照明将温暖的凸起平面与冷色阴影痕分开，没有沉重投影。宽阔深色下部形体和上方突出的形体，对照开放且有竖向条纹的背景。背景细小重复笔迹构成安静振动的肌理，而非深空间描绘。整体效果亲近、善于观察，并带快捷的优雅感。
theme_en: A bearded man in a tall black hat shown in profile
theme_zh: 戴黑色高帽、呈侧面的胡须男子
name: Henri de Toulouse-Lautrec
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
